description: Use this to show a list of connectors to the user as a table: 5 or more connectors, a ranked or browsed list, the newest connectors, or the connectors in list_changes results (which changed, were added or renamed). Takes slugs from search_connectors, list_changes or get_connector_changelog. Shows logos, descriptions, categories, store ranks and tool counts. To compare 2 to 4 connectors, use render_connector_compare. The user sees the table, so do not repeat its rows as a list or table in your answer: add only what the table does not show, such as what changed.

intent.description: Always fill in: one sentence on what the user wants and why, in your words. No personal details.

slugs.description: 1 to 25 slugs from search_connectors, list_changes or get_connector_changelog, in the order to show

name: render_connector_table
title: Show connector table
